43-3031.00:2487.short: Key supplier and agency invoices into AFAS, match them to orders or hours, post them, and pull lists into Excel.

steps.what: Collect invoices from the AP mailbox and agency portals
Enter invoice header and lines in AFAS

loop.output: supplier, invoice number, date, amounts, VAT lines
loop.check: supplier found by KvK, VAT number and IBAN in AFAS; lines add up to totals; VAT sums match
loop.stop: one pass plus one retry; any failed check sends the invoice to the bookkeeper queue
loop.why_not_simpler: UBL invoices are read by AFAS; PDFs from small suppliers have no fixed layout

steps.what: Match invoice to purchase order, receipt or agency hours
Post and file the invoice
Export lists to Excel for open-item analysis

A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform matches the three agencies' invoices to the hours in their portals and AFAS, and a Power BI page replaces the Excel open-items exports.

43-3031.00:2487.enabler_now: AFAS Profit 8 reads UBL and PDF to line level and books one-to-one matches; AI coding makes the agency hours matcher a few days of work; models read odd PDFs well enough when checked against totals.
43-3031.00:2487.still_hard: Agency portals without a stable export, partial deliveries, and suppliers who keep sending PDFs; the touchless share will be lower than vendors claim.

ambition.what: Check every agency invoice line against worked hours before payment, instead of spot checks.

43-3031.00:2487.altitude: The bookkeeper works an exception queue instead of keying, and gains the right to set match tolerances and block supplier records with bad master data.

AFAS Scan & herken turns a PDF into an e-invoice, finds supplier by KvK, VAT number and IBAN, gaps filled by hand
NetSuite case: capture time per invoice fell from 2.5 minutes to 45 seconds
Measured touchless shares often disappoint because of own accounts, VAT codes and exceptions

43-3031.00:2486.short: Check postings, VAT codes, ledger accounts and sums for errors, and correct them before close.

steps.what: Pull posting lists and suspense balances from AFAS
Check VAT codes, accounts and cost centres against supplier norms
Find duplicates, IBAN changes and sum errors
Investigate unmatched bank lines and odd postings

loop.input: unmatched CAMT.053 line or flagged posting with candidate open items and payment description
loop.output: proposed match or likely cause with the evidence lines
loop.check: proposed amounts sum exactly to the bank line; the bookkeeper accepts or rejects
loop.stop: top three candidates only; no candidate above threshold goes to the queue as unexplained
loop.why_not_simpler: AFAS rules match on reference, IBAN and invoice number; the leftovers have free-text descriptions and combined payments

steps.what: Post correcting entries

43-3031.00:2486.design: A nightly rule job on the AFAS extract checks every posting for VAT code against supplier country and type, account against the supplier's usual account, duplicates and IBAN changes, and posts the hits to a Power BI exception page with a Teams notice. AFAS bank matching stays the first line; a bounded model loop proposes matches for the leftover bank lines, and the bookkeeper accepts and corrects.
43-3031.00:2486.previous_blocker: Checks lived in personal Excel sheets run before close, so errors were found weeks late and rules were never written down.
43-3031.00:2486.enabler_now: The nightly AFAS extract already feeds Power BI; rule checks are quick to code; models can read free-text bank descriptions under a sum check.
43-3031.00:2486.still_hard: Writing the norms per supplier and VAT case (reverse charge, intra-EU) and keeping them current; false alarms will need tuning in the first months.
43-3031.00:2486.human_edge: Judging whether an odd posting is an error, a one-off deal, or a sign of fraud, and talking to the budget holder about it.

ambition.what: Check every posting daily instead of a sample at month end, which takes days off the close.

43-3031.00:2486.altitude: The bookkeeper reviews a daily exception list and owns the check rules with the controller; they can hold a payment when an IBAN change is not confirmed.

reach.task: Prepare month-end reconciliations and VAT return
reach.learn: Which posting errors cause audit adjustments, so checks target those first.

evidence.claim: AFAS matches CAMT.053 lines on reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums; misses go to a person
Since October 2025 banks check payee name against IBAN, but a payer who confirms after a warning is not blocked
Let AP run with people on exceptions and log every decision with its data

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract includes posting lines, VAT codes and supplier master data
The controller will agree to own the rule list with the bookkeepers
unknowns: Number of audit adjustments last year and their cause
Share of bank lines AFAS matches automatically today
Whether IBAN changes are logged with who changed them
research_questions: Which errors drove last year's audit adjustments, and could a rule have caught them?
What share of bank lines stays unmatched after AFAS rules each month?
How many alerts per day would the draft rules raise on three months of history?

43-3031.00:2493.short: Assign ledger account, cost centre, site and VAT code to each invoice per the coding procedure.

steps.what: Read the invoice and decide what was bought for which site

loop.input: invoice lines of a new supplier or a free-text line with no default coding
loop.output: proposed ledger account, cost centre and VAT code with a reason
loop.check: code exists and is allowed for that site; VAT code fits supplier country and reverse-charge flag; confidence above threshold
loop.stop: one proposal per line; below threshold or failed check goes to the bookkeeper
loop.why_not_simpler: Most invoices use supplier defaults; the rest are free-text lines that rules cannot map

steps.what: Look up the coding procedure and past codings
Enter codes on the invoice lines
Chase the budget holder by mail for approval

43-3031.00:2493.design: Set default ledger account, cost centre and VAT code on every regular supplier in AFAS so most invoices code themselves, and move approval from email into the AFAS approval workflow with reminders. A small model loop proposes codes only for new suppliers and free-text lines, checked against the allowed code list, and the bookkeeper confirms.
43-3031.00:2493.previous_blocker: Supplier defaults were never maintained, the procedure sat in a SharePoint document, and approvals ran by email, so coding was done by memory.
43-3031.00:2493.enabler_now: AFAS supports supplier defaults and digital approval out of the box; models can classify free-text lines against a fixed code list with a check.
43-3031.00:2493.still_hard: Mixed invoices that span sites or cost types, and budget holders on warehouse shifts who do not open AFAS.
43-3031.00:2493.human_edge: Deciding the right code when an invoice is genuinely unclear and agreeing it with the controller so it stays consistent.

ambition.what: Spend by site and cost type that the FP&A analysts can trust daily, because coding is consistent.

43-3031.00:2493.altitude: The bookkeeper maintains supplier defaults and the code list instead of coding line by line, and decides when a new supplier gets a default.

reach.task: Build the cost forecast per site
reach.learn: Which cost centres and accounts the forecast relies on, so coding errors that hurt it get fixed first.

evidence.claim: Coding suggested from vendor history for the team to review and confirm
70% of Dutch respondents approve invoices on paper or by email; 43% say this regularly delays payment
Own ledger accounts, VAT codes and exceptions block full automation
Intra-EU and reverse-charge purchases may need reporting within 5 days of receipt under ViDA, so slow approval rounds are a risk

Budget holders can use AFAS approval on phone or Pocket app
unknowns: How many active suppliers have defaults set today
Average days from receipt to approval
How many invoices span more than one site
research_questions: What share of last year's invoice lines would a supplier default have coded correctly?
How long do approvals take today, and which budget holders cause most delay?
How often does the bookkeeper change codes after the accountant's review?

43-3031.00:2497.short: Calculate amounts due, payment discounts, late interest, g-rekening splits and balances for payments and customers.

steps.what: Work out due dates and payment discounts for the payment run
Split agency invoices into g-rekening and normal account share
Check payment proposal, IBAN warnings and approve the batch
Calculate late interest and overdue balances on customer accounts
Answer one-off balance and amount questions

43-3031.00:2497.design: Configure payment terms, discounts, dunning and interest calculation in AFAS so the payment proposal and interest invoices come out of the system, with a check that no small supplier gets terms over 30 days. Deterministic code on the agency invoice applies the agreed wage tax and VAT share to the g-rekening and adds it to the payment batch; the bookkeeper approves the batch in Rabobank after reviewing IBAN-name warnings and new payees.
43-3031.00:2497.previous_blocker: Terms and agency percentages were kept in Excel, interest was charged by hand when someone noticed, and the g-rekening split was keyed per invoice.
43-3031.00:2497.enabler_now: AFAS already does terms, discounts and dunning when set up; the g-rekening split is a few lines of code; the bank IBAN-name check flags wrong payees.
43-3031.00:2497.still_hard: Agreeing with sales whether to charge interest to key customers, and keeping agency g-rekening percentages and statements current.
43-3031.00:2497.human_edge: Approving money leaving the bank and deciding when a warning is real; choosing with collections when charging interest hurts a customer relationship.

ambition.what: Apply late-payment interest and early-payment discounts on every eligible invoice instead of when noticed.

43-3031.00:2497.altitude: The bookkeeper approves batches and maintains terms and g-rekening percentages instead of calculating; they gain a say with collections on interest waivers.

reach.task: Chase overdue customers and agree payment plans
reach.learn: Which customers pay late on purpose, so interest and terms are set per customer.

evidence.claim: Inlener can be liable for agency wage tax and VAT and limits this by paying that share into the agency's g-rekening
Banks check payee name against IBAN since October 2025; a payer who confirms after a warning is not blocked
A large company may not agree more than 30 days with a small supplier
AFAS supports payment terms, discounts and dunning with interest

assumptions: The three agencies have g-rekeningen and agreed percentages
Customer contracts allow late-payment interest
unknowns: Whether interest is charged today at all, and on which customers
Current g-rekening percentages per agency
Which suppliers count as small under BW 6:119a
research_questions: How much early-payment discount was missed last year?
How much late interest could have been charged on overdue receivables last year, and would sales accept it?
Are g-rekening payments made on every agency invoice today, and with which percentage?

43-3031.00:2496.short: Match bank, ledger and agency invoice lines; chase and report what does not match.

steps.what: Import Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and run AFAS automatic bank matching
Work through unmatched bank lines, search invoices and payment references

loop.input: unmatched bank line with free-text description plus candidate open items from AFAS
loop.output: ranked match proposal with one-line reason, or 'no match'
loop.check: proposal must sum exactly to the bank amount (or within the set tolerance) and refer to an existing open item; otherwise discarded
loop.stop: one pass per line, max 3 candidates; no valid proposal goes to the bookkeeper's queue unchanged
loop.why_not_simpler: Descriptions like 'fact 2026-0412 + 0415 minus credit' or a parent company paying for a subsidiary are free text that fixed rules miss.

steps.what: Reconcile AP and AR subledgers and agency invoices against ledger and hours
Ask suppliers, customers or colleagues for missing data by email

loop.input: discrepancy item with amounts, invoice numbers and supplier contact
loop.output: short Dutch or English query email draft
loop.check: amounts and numbers in the draft are compared to the source record; mismatch blocks the draft
loop.stop: one draft per item; the bookkeeper edits and sends
loop.why_not_simpler: A template covers the common cases; the loop only adds value for odd cases, so it can be dropped if templates suffice.

steps.what: Summarise open discrepancies for the controller at month close

43-3031.00:2496.design: Turn on and tune AFAS bank matching with tolerances, and replace the reconciliation Excel sheets with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that reads AFAS open items, ledger balances and the three agency portals' hours and invoices. A bounded model step proposes matches for leftover bank lines; everything that stays unmatched lands in one queue and a Power BI page the controller reads at close.
43-3031.00:2496.previous_blocker: Agency portal data and AFAS lived in separate exports joined by hand in Excel, and free-text bank descriptions defeated fixed rules.
43-3031.00:2496.enabler_now: AFAS matching rules already cover the bulk [S3]; scripting the portal and AFAS joins is now cheap to build, and a small model can read free-text bank descriptions.
43-3031.00:2496.still_hard: Getting stable exports from three agency portals, and partial or combined payments from customers that no rule or model can resolve without asking.
43-3031.00:2496.human_edge: Deciding whether a difference is an error, a dispute or a fraud signal, and who should be asked about it.

ambition.what: Daily instead of monthly reconciliation of agency invoices against hours, so overbilling is caught before payment.

43-3031.00:2496.altitude: The bookkeeper spends the week on a short exception queue and owns match rules and tolerances; they can set tolerances within limits agreed with the controller.

reach.learn: Which reconciliations block the close and what evidence the auditor wants.
How unmatched receipts relate to disputed invoices.

evidence.claim: AFAS matches CAMT.053 lines on reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums, with optional tolerance; misses go to a person.
Exceptions should go to people with every decision logged with its data.
Noordhaven can be liable for agencies' unpaid wage tax and VAT, so agency invoices need checking.

assumptions: Bank statements are already imported into AFAS as CAMT.053.
Agency portals offer an export or API of hours and invoices.
unknowns: Current share of bank lines AFAS matches automatically.
Whether the three agency portals allow API access or only manual downloads.
How many discrepancies per month reach the controller today.

43-3031.00:2494.short: Answer supplier and internal questions about invoices, payments and account balances by looking them up in AFAS.

steps.what: Receive question by mail, Teams or phone

loop.input: Incoming mail in the AP shared mailbox
loop.output: Question type (payment status, balance, copy invoice, other) and extracted invoice number, KvK or supplier name
loop.check: Extracted invoice or supplier number must exist in AFAS; otherwise the mail is marked unclassified
loop.stop: One pass per mail; unclassified mails go to the normal queue
loop.why_not_simpler: Suppliers write free text in Dutch and English with invoice numbers in varying formats.

steps.what: Look up invoice, approval and payment status in AFAS
Check related documents and bank payment
Write and send the reply

loop.input: Question and AFAS status facts (invoice, approval step, due date, payment date)
loop.output: Draft reply in the supplier's language
loop.check: Every date and amount in the draft must equal the AFAS facts; drafts mentioning anything not in the facts are rejected
loop.stop: Two attempts, then a fixed template is used
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cover plain status; mixed questions need a short tailored answer.

43-3031.00:2494.design: Route the AP shared mailbox through a small workflow that classifies each mail, looks up the invoice in AFAS via its connectors and drafts a reply in Outlook for the bookkeeper to approve. Internal budget holders get a Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract showing open invoices and approval status for their cost centre, so their questions stop.
43-3031.00:2494.previous_blocker: Every question needed a person to search AFAS screens, and there was no safe way to read free-text mails or to expose AP data to budget holders.
43-3031.00:2494.enabler_now: AFAS connectors give read access to invoice and payment status, models can classify mails and draft short replies, and Power BI already runs on an AFAS extract.
43-3031.00:2494.still_hard: Questions about disputed invoices, credit notes or changed bank details need a person. Showing data to budget holders needs row-level security per cost centre.
43-3031.00:2494.human_edge: Handling an annoyed supplier, a disputed amount or a request to change bank details needs judgement and relationship care.

ambition.what: Give site and department budget holders in Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo a self-service view of their open invoices and approval status.

43-3031.00:2494.altitude: The bookkeeper approves drafted replies in batches and keeps the hard conversations. Nothing changes in their decision rights.

reach.learn: How the same lookup and draft flow can serve customers asking about their balance.

reach.task: Power BI security and data model
reach.learn: How row-level security per cost centre is set up on the AFAS extract.

evidence.claim: Questions and correspondence on payment status from AFAS as a gated agent, autonomy 3.
70% of Dutch respondents approve invoices on paper or by mail, and 43% say this regularly delays payment, which drives status questions.

Payment status questions are the largest group.
Mail processing by a model is covered by the existing Microsoft 365 data agreements under the AVG.
unknowns: How many questions per week arrive and by which channel.
Whether budget holders may see supplier invoice details under internal policy.
Whether the works council needs to be consulted if mail handling is logged per employee.

How often would a drafted reply have been sent unchanged in a two-week shadow test?
Do budget holders use a self-service view, measured by internal questions before and after?

43-3031.00:2490.short: Assign ledger account, cost centre and VAT code to transactions and summarise records for the close.

loop.output: suggested ledger account, cost centre, site and VAT code with a reason
loop.check: account and cost centre must exist and be allowed for the supplier group; VAT code must fit supplier country and reverse-charge rules; deviation from supplier default is flagged
loop.stop: one suggestion per line; failed check or new supplier goes to the bookkeeper uncoded
loop.why_not_simpler: supplier defaults in AFAS cover fixed suppliers, but mixed invoices and new suppliers need reading the line text

steps.what: Record bank costs, credit notes and small receipts
Build summaries of costs per site and open items in Excel
Answer controller and site questions about how items were coded

Bank lines and costs are booked by AFAS bank rules, and the Excel summaries become a Power BI page per site on the nightly extract, with drill-down to the coded line and the reason.
43-3031.00:2490.previous_blocker: Coding depended on each bookkeeper's memory of suppliers and sites, and own accounts and VAT codes made rule sets incomplete.
43-3031.00:2490.enabler_now: Coding suggestions from vendor history are now common in AP tools, and a checked suggestion step can be built cheaply around AFAS data.
43-3031.00:2490.still_hard: Mixed invoices across sites and new suppliers; touchless rates often fall short of vendor claims.
43-3031.00:2490.human_edge: Judging the right account and VAT treatment for unusual purchases and explaining the choice to the controller or auditor.

ambition.what: Site managers in Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo get a weekly cost-per-site view they never had

43-3031.00:2490.altitude: The bookkeeper confirms suggestions and maintains supplier defaults and the allowed-account table, a decision right shared with the controller.

reach.learn: Which cost centres and splits FP&A needs so coding feeds the forecast directly
What reasons per coded line the auditor wants to see

Own ledger accounts, VAT codes and exceptions per administration block touchless processing
AFAS matches bank lines on reference, IBAN and invoice number by rules

Power BI licences can be extended to site managers

Whether invoice data may be sent to a model endpoint under the current AVG processing agreement

43-3031.00:2489.short: Key debits and credits into AFAS and total accounts in Excel to check they balance.

Export balances and total accounts in Excel to check
Post recurring entries such as rent, leases and accruals
Make corrections and reclassifications found in review

43-3031.00:2489.previous_blocker: Workings came in many Excel layouts, and nobody owned a template or import routine, so keying was the safe default.
43-3031.00:2489.enabler_now: AFAS connectors and AI-assisted coding make a validated import script a few days of work; Power BI already reads AFAS nightly.
43-3031.00:2489.still_hard: Getting colleagues to use one template, and the corrections that need judgement on accounts and periods.
43-3031.00:2489.human_edge: Knowing which account and period an odd item belongs to and spotting an entry that balances but is wrong.
43-3031.00:2489.altitude: Less keying; the bookkeeper releases imported batches and handles corrections, with no new decision rights.

reach.learn: Which accruals recur and can move to AFAS periodic entries

Log every decision with its data and let people handle exceptions

Power BI extract includes ledger balances
unknowns: How many manual journal entries are keyed per month

43-3031.00:2509.short: Check each supplier and agency invoice against the order, goods receipt or hours, then record it in AFAS.

Look up the purchase order and goods receipt for each invoice
Compare lines, quantities and prices; post clean matches for approval

Chase mismatches with the buyer, site manager or supplier

Noordhaven can limit chain liability by paying the wage tax and VAT share into the agency's g-rekening

Post payroll journal to ledger with cost centre per site
Prepare net wage, wage tax and pension payment batches
Reconcile payroll clearing accounts after payment
Resolve differences with the payroll specialist

43-3031.00:2501.short: Select due payables, calculate amounts and splits, build the payment batch and send it to Rabobank.

Calculate amounts, discounts and the g-rekening split for agency invoices
Check IBAN changes, duplicates, terms and name-check warnings

Get batch signed and released in the bank
